steps.label: the run starts on the title screen (startAt): the Mods button is on it
select the BuildCraft row: list rows are not widgets, so click by position (alphabetical list, GUI scale 2; the >=26.2 list is icon rows, the older one sorts Minecraft first)
select the BuildCraft row on Forge: its own mod list (net.minecraftforge.client.gui.ModListScreen) sorts Minecraft first, rows 26 GUI units tall, BuildCraft Redux the second

steps.name: modlist-banner
steps.look: info panel shows the new banner: crane, BuildCraft wordmark, yellow REDUX in the hazard bar, five gears (no obsidian), 'based on BuildCraft by SpaceToad' readable; name reads BuildCraft Redux; mod-list icon is the gear icon. On Fabric the list is Mod Menu's: it has no banner, so check only the name, the gear icon and the description
